newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol offers South Blend, YPF sells Escalante.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol offers South Blend, YPF sells Escalante.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol is seeking bids for more South Blend crude after recently selling three cargoes to a European refiner who took the shipments to Peru, traders said on Friday.
The 380,000 barrel cargoes will load one each month from November through January, traders said.
The price of the prior sale remains confidential.

"This crude was sold on the Pacific side, so refiners may have been willing to pay more," a trader said, noting Pacific shipments could avoid Panama Canal costs. The sale was rumored done between $2.25 and $2.85 below West Texas Intermediate.
Separately, traders said YPF offered 380,000 barrels of Escalante for Nov 23-24, around WTI minus $3.05 a barrel fob.
On Thursday, Petrobras bought a cargo of Escalante at December WTI minus $3.12 a barrel fob.
